scope: Redis exact-scope validated scene-tool metadata cache
Redis Stream version notifications and authenticated SSE task progress
Qt live stage display, bounded snapshot refresh and polling fallback

full.dependencies: Temporary isolated real PostgreSQL and Redis; existing backend and migration suites included

coverage: Real PostgreSQL/Redis HTTP replicas share committed metadata and final progress
Account, device, authorization epoch, complete-input and namespace isolation
Expired, future-dated, malformed, oversized, failed, empty and clarification cache results
Preserved original checkedAt; fresh release queries bypass cache
Rejected commits and cancelled revisions cannot populate or adopt cached data
Cache hits preserve locked/excluded tracks without incrementing toolCalls
SSE authentication, revoked sessions, cursors, heartbeat, bounded connections, backpressure, final state and shutdown cleanup
Atomic Redis Stream append plus TTL; lost notification/database fallback
Qt fragmented and numeric-timestamp frames, late/duplicate events, single GET flight, final-version catch-up, disconnect/reconnect and old-backend compatibility

controlledComparison.type: One deterministic exact-repeat scenario with a local synthetic model/catalog and real isolated Redis
controlledComparison.interpretation: Demonstrates reuse for this exact-repeat fixture only; does not estimate online hit rate, latency improvement or recommendation accuracy.

cachePolicy.failure: miss, then existing live tool path and budgets
cachePolicy.stored: Whitelisted metadata and original source timestamps only; no cookies, authorization tokens, playback URLs or model reasoning

progressPolicy.lastEventId: Current state version; reconnect sends latest state, not full event-history replay

failureAudit.finding: Concurrent create could return AI_BUSY while a cancelled graph promise was still winding down locally.
failureAudit.resolution: Ignore the non-authoritative jobs map for PostgreSQL admission; retain live paid-call and persistent guards. Added deterministic completion regression.

failureAudit.finding: First attempted admission repair changed an active-task Redis-outage response and did not remove the stale graph guard before model execution.
failureAudit.resolution: Retained original preflight and fixed the underlying PostgreSQL jobs-map check. Final existing and new regression cases pass.

failureAudit.finding: Existing request-field allowlist required the new non-sensitive catalogContext field.
failureAudit.resolution: Updated contract assertion; strict reserved fields remain protected.

failureAudit.finding: Offscreen Qt media backend did not advance the synthetic WAV playback clock.
failureAudit.resolution: Reran the actual native platform; complete business flow passed 4/4.

limitations: No paid or fresh real-model recommendation-quality evaluation in this upgrade
No online cache-hit-rate or end-to-end latency benchmark
No public production capacity, multi-region or high-availability certification
Task progress does not replay model reasoning or offer exactly-once provider billing
Redis queues and account-synced long-term preferences remain outside this upgrade
